article_blocks.text: Strain Type: Mostly indica F1 hybrid
Genetics: Sensi Star × Warlock
Breeder: Gerrit of Magus Genetics
THC Content: 29%
CBD Content: Low
Terpene Profile: caryophyllene , myrcene , limonene
Primary Flavors: Sweet fruit, citrus, spice, herbs
Flowering Time (Indoor): 8–9 weeks
Outdoor Harvest Time: Late October
Indoor Yield: 300–500 g/m²
Outdoor Yield: Moderate
Grow Difficulty: Easy to moderate

Motavation may have one of the more misleading names in cannabis. Rather than inspiring a burst of physical productivity, this compact Dutch hybrid is famous for doing almost the opposite: filling the mind with ideas while encouraging the body to remain exactly where it is. Gerrit of Magus Genetics developed the cultivar through a long breeding project combining Sensi Star and Warlock, with experimental versions circulating under names including Starwarz, Medizin Power, and London Memories before the final selection became Motavation.

Serious Seeds later acquired and preserved the Magus collection and now maintains the original genetics. The breeder describes a short, stocky plant covered in an unusually thick layer of resin, producing a powerful sweet aroma with an odd fresh-paint undertone and an overwhelmingly physical high. With an eight-to-nine-week flowering period, yields of roughly 300–500 g/m², and a natural suitability for low indoor spaces, Motavation remains a particularly successful example of old-school indica-focused marijuana breeding.
Genetics and Lineage

The authentic lineage is Sensi Star × Warlock. Serious Seeds identifies Motavation as the final product of a long Magus Genetics breeding program intended to create an ideal indoor cannabis plant. During development, intermediate genetic lines were known as Starwarz, Medizin Power, and London Memories before Gerrit settled on the final cultivar. This extended development process is important because Motavation was not simply a one-generation commercial cross given a new name; it emerged from repeated selection for compact stature, resin production, potency, and a distinctive effect.

Warlock contributes particularly interesting characteristics to the family. Serious Seeds describes Warlock as a mostly indica Afghani / Skunk hybrid with compact vegetative growth, large flowers, strong sweetness, and a surprisingly cerebral high. Sensi Star contributes another powerful indica-oriented influence and helps explain Motavation’s short structure, dense resin, and much heavier physical effect. The pairing gives the finished plant an unusual split personality: structurally and physically it behaves like a strong indica, yet mentally it can remain imaginative and active long after the body has become reluctant to move.

The strain’s history also reflects the connection between two respected Dutch breeding houses. Magus Genetics developed Motavation, Warlock, Double Dutch , and Biddy Early, while Serious Seeds acquired those surviving Magus varieties in 2012 when Gerrit stepped away from the seed business. Serious Seeds states that the purpose of the acquisition was to preserve the original Magus genetic lines rather than allow them to disappear.
Effects and Experience

The effects develop with a striking separation between mind and body. Physically, the cultivar can become extremely heavy. Serious Seeds describes the body sensation as overwhelming, with a level of stoned relaxation capable of keeping the consumer firmly on the couch. At the same time, the mind may remain active and full of ideas. That contrast is the reason the name works as a joke: there may be plenty of mental motivation, but the physical energy required to act on those thoughts can be noticeably absent.

Early in the session, there can be a brief period of mental brightness, amusement, and creative thinking before the heavier indica component takes command. Music, films, drawing, brainstorming, or simply allowing thoughts to wander can become particularly enjoyable. This is not typically the kind of weed chosen for exercise, chores, or demanding social obligations. As the body stone deepens, remaining seated becomes increasingly attractive and concentration can become less structured.

Serious Seeds currently rates THC as “very high” and CBD as low rather than publishing a fixed laboratory percentage. That is more useful than attaching an unsupported universal number to the cultivar. Actual potency will vary with phenotype, lighting, nutrition, harvest maturity, curing, and testing methodology. Consumers unfamiliar with a particular batch should therefore begin conservatively, especially because strong physical effects can become substantially more sedating at higher doses.
Medical Benefits

Motavation has a genuine history of being selected with medical use in mind. Serious Seeds recounts that while the strain was still under development, Gerrit sent test seeds to an Austrian grower seeking an indica with medicinal potential. The resulting plants became popular among a group of medical cannabis patients and were referred to at the time as Medizin Power. Serious Seeds continues to describe the cultivar as especially useful for relaxation and pain relief.

Its strongly physical character may appeal to consumers who prefer marijuana for evening relaxation, muscular tension, or temporary discomfort. The heavy body effect can also make the strain attractive when settling down for the night is more important than maintaining productivity. Meanwhile, the active mental component may keep the experience from feeling entirely dull or emotionally flat.

Those historical uses should not be interpreted as clinical proof that Motavation treats pain, depression, insomnia, anxiety, or another medical condition. Named cannabis strains are not standardized pharmaceutical preparations, and cannabinoid concentrations can vary significantly. High-THC weed may also produce dizziness, anxiety, dry mouth, impaired coordination, or excessive sedation. Medical consumers should rely on tested product chemistry and appropriate healthcare guidance for ongoing conditions.
Flavor Profile and Aroma

Motavation’s smell is unusually difficult to reduce to conventional fruit or dessert terminology. Serious Seeds describes flowering plants as producing a powerful sweet fragrance with an undertone reminiscent of fresh paint. That chemical edge gives the cultivar a distinctive old-school quality. Sweet fruit and citrus may appear at first, followed by spice, herbs, resin, and the strange solvent-like sharpness that makes the aroma memorable.

The flavor usually feels warmer and more rounded than the raw fragrance. Fruit sweetness and citrus can lead on the inhale, while earthy spice and slightly chemical notes become more noticeable afterward. Warlock’s sweet, acidic fruit influence helps explain part of this profile, while the heavier indica ancestry contributes additional resinous depth.

No standardized terpene panel is published for Motavation, so fixed claims about dominant terpenes would create unnecessary precision. Caryophyllene would be compatible with its spice, limonene with citrus brightness, and myrcene with earthy depth and fruitiness. The unusual fresh-paint note likely reflects a more complicated mixture of volatile aromatic compounds rather than one terpene alone.
Growing Information

Motavation was specifically developed as an indoor-friendly plant. Serious Seeds describes it as short, squat, and well suited to closets or grow rooms where vertical space is limited. Four to five weeks of vegetative growth is the breeder’s current recommendation, after which plants generally require eight to nine weeks of flowering. This compact structure makes the cultivar easier to manage than taller sativa-oriented hybrids and allows growers to use available light efficiently.

Resin production is exceptional. Flowers and surrounding sugar leaves develop such a thick layer of glands that Serious Seeds notes the foliage requires relatively little manicuring because so much of it remains valuable resin-covered material. This characteristic also makes Motavation attractive for hash or concentrate production. Dense resinous buds should still be provided with good airflow, particularly as flowering nears completion and interior humidity becomes harder to control.

Indoor yields are officially listed at approximately 300–500 g/m², while late October is the breeder’s outdoor harvest estimate. Outdoors, the plant’s compact architecture can be useful where discretion matters, although the relatively late finish means wetter northern climates require attention to autumn moisture. Indoors remains the environment for which the genetics were principally selected.

Motavation has also accumulated significant competition recognition. Serious Seeds lists four awards and notes that the cultivar won first place in the Indica category at the 2013 Expogrow Cup in Irun, Spain. That success reinforces its reputation as more than a productive indoor strain; resin quality and finished flower characteristics have also been competitive at a high level.
FAQ
What are the genetics of Motavation?

Motavation is Sensi Star × Warlock. Gerrit of Magus Genetics developed the cross through a long selection project before releasing the final cultivar. Serious Seeds later acquired and preserved the Magus Genetics line.
Is Motavation indica or sativa?

Serious Seeds classifies Motavation as a mostly indica F1 hybrid. Its compact growth, extremely heavy body effects, and dense resin production strongly reflect the indica side, although the mental experience can remain creative and active.
What does Motavation taste like?
The strain combines sweet fruit, citrus, spice, herbs, and an unusual chemical quality. The breeder specifically describes the aroma as sweet with an undertone reminiscent of fresh paint.
How long does Motavation take to flower?
Indoor flowering takes approximately eight to nine weeks after a recommended four-to-five-week vegetative period. Serious Seeds lists outdoor harvest for late October.
Is Motavation a high-yielding strain?

It produces moderate to high indoor harvests, with Serious Seeds listing approximately 300–500 grams per square meter. Its compact stature makes that production particularly attractive in rooms where height is restricted.
Final Thoughts on Motavation

Motavation is a cultivar built around contradiction. The mind can feel creative and full of possibilities while the body becomes deeply relaxed and increasingly unwilling to participate. That unusual separation between cerebral activity and physical heaviness gives the strain considerably more personality than a typical sedating indica.

Its breeding history is equally substantial. Magus Genetics spent years developing Sensi Star × Warlock selections under names including Starwarz, Medizin Power, and London Memories before arriving at the final plant, and Serious Seeds later preserved the genetics when it acquired the surviving Magus catalog.

For growers, Motavation offers a compact indoor structure, eight-to-nine-week flowering, yields reaching roughly 500 g/m², and extraordinary resin coverage. For consumers, sweet citrus and fruit mix with spice and a peculiar fresh-paint sharpness before giving way to one of the cultivar’s defining traits: an intensely relaxing body stone accompanied by a surprisingly active imagination. Motavation may not make anyone more physically productive, but as an old-school Dutch indica bred for resin, potency, and deep relaxation, it has more than earned its place in the Magus Genetics legacy.
